rows.context_and_review_note: Added safely to current editing RAM limit, preserving the source safe-budget qualifier explicitly. Retained the OR between exceeding the policy allowance and Android being unable to make the needed RAM available: no assumption that every actual allocation failure was predicted by the estimate. ImageResizeDialog.kt:27 is the reason label; ImageImport.kt:148 onward uses separate decoded/output bitmaps and does not write the original source file. The copy is resized for editing; original unchanged is scoped to this import/resize operation, not later explicit Save actions or perpetual file retention. RAM for the full image and work on it is a functional buffers paraphrase, not storage bytes. No eventual resize-success guarantee is introduced.
